purpose: Normalized promoted state semantics plus cross-build racer relations.

entries.name: Player1/2_AngularVelocity
entries.notes: Persistent paired angular-velocity slots. `81:8D9C-8D9F` copies P1 `0BAD` into shared `0F4B` and `81:8E11-8E14` writes it back; the P2 bridge mirrors the same relation with `0BAF` at `81:8EF6-8EF9` / `81:8F65-8F68`.

entries.name: Player1/2_RacerPresentationId
entries.notes: Persistent per-racer presentation/frame identities. The player-state bridge copies each through current-player working state during simulation; `83:F0BB` reads them directly and `83:F296` resolves each ID into the packed racer presentation stream. Retained ordinary-2P checkpoints observe IDs `0542/0540` at frame 1220 and `057E/0544` at frame 1420.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_RacerPresentationId
entries.notes: Shared current-player presentation ID. Player 1 copies `0FE9→0F97→0FE9`; player 2 copies `0FEB→0F97→0FEB`; `83:ED2F` updates the working identity during the common racer pass.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_PitchAngleWorking
entries.notes: Shared current-player pitch/orientation workspace. The player-state marshal loads it from persistent P1 `04C7` or P2 `04C9`; stunt finalization reads it to track quadrant transitions.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_AngularVelocityWorking
entries.notes: Shared current-player angular-velocity workspace. The bank-81 player-state bridge round-trips persistent `0BAD/0BAF` through this slot for the common simulation pass. Distinct from `0F4D`, which is a separate per-frame rotation delta used by stunt logic.

entries.name: RaceTimer_MinutesDigit
entries.notes: Shared race/stunt timer minutes digit. Count-up path `81:C74A-C74E` increments it; stunt countdown `81:C83A-C83E` decrements it. Finish handling snapshots it for the active player at `81:80BE-C1`.

entries.name: RaceTimer_TensSecondsDigit
entries.notes: Timer tens-of-seconds digit, range 0-5 in normal operation. Count-up carries here at `81:C738-C747`; countdown borrows through it at `81:C82B-C837`.

entries.name: RaceTimer_SecondsDigit
entries.notes: Timer ones-of-seconds digit, range 0-9. Count-up and countdown mutate it at `81:C723-C735` and `81:C819-C828`; finish handling includes it in the active-player time snapshot.

entries.name: RaceTimer_TenthsDigit
entries.notes: Timer tenths digit, range 0-9. The count-up path increments it after six sub-ticks; stunt countdown decrements it after six sub-ticks.

entries.name: RaceTimer_SubTick
entries.notes: Six-step timer phase. Both timer directions advance this field and roll it at 6 before changing the tenths digit, giving the timer its 1/10-second cadence.

entries.name: Frontend_CurrentMenu
entries.notes: Stable deterministic checkpoints correlate `0xD7` main menu, `0x3C` one-player rider select, `0x6D` first one-player tours page, `0xF6` one-player track select, `0x16` now-playing, then `0x00` after race entry. Do not treat it as continuously semantic: bank-80 text/layout handlers also reuse DP `$9F` as a tile/text position accumulator during frontend construction.

entries.name: Frontend_SelectedOption
entries.notes: Recovered bot uses it for main-menu/tour selection. Native captures show `0x00` at clean main menu and first tours page, consistent with bot policy. On TOUR_SELECT it holds the medal-matrix tour row (Crawler 0, Jumper 1, Shuffler 2 … Hunter 8). Down steps it by 2 because even rows are the left column; confirmed on page `0x6D` (`00→02`) and on the nine-tour page `0x10` (`00→08`, HUNTER).

entries.name: Frontend_SelectedTourRow
entries.notes: Tour row used by `83:9EB4` medal indexing (`16 * D0 + rider`). The tier probe reads `0` for Crawler, `2` for Shuffler and `8` for Hunter on TRACK_SELECT after confirming the matching `$009B`.

entries.name: Frontend_SelectedRow
entries.notes: Recovered bot label. On PLAYER_SELECT_P1 the reference harness steps it `0x00..0x07` down the eight rider rows; confirming row r selects rider `2r + column`. Exact semantics outside these menus not yet tested.

entries.name: Frontend_SelectedColumn
entries.notes: Recovered bot label; native captures change with frontend scene/selection. On PLAYER_SELECT_P1 `0x06` is the left column and `0x07` the right; other screens reuse it (e.g. `0xFD` after confirm).

entries.name: P1_RiderIndex
entries.notes: Player-one rider identity 0..15, written on PLAYER_SELECT_P1 confirm as `2 * row + column` (confirmed for MIKE 0, ANDREW 1, MARTIN 2, AMY 4, STEVE 15). It is the medal-matrix column and selects in-race palette asset `0x06 + index`; `$017F` is the P2 counterpart. Preset table: `analysis/generated/legacy-cast-presets.json`.

entries.name: Save_PlayerNameTable
entries.notes: Player-name records copied from ROM `83:800C` at format: indices 0..15 racers, 16 `someone`, 17 `bronsen`, 18 `silvia`, 19 `goldwyn`, 20 `anti-uni`, then League slots. Default records are 8 chars `_`-padded + `FF FF`; RENAME PLAYER writes lowercase chars + `FF` (`analysis/generated/name-entry-probe.json`).

entries.name: Save_RiderStats
entries.notes: Per-rider lifetime stats at `0x0230 + 8*rider`: +0 PLAYED, +2 WON, +4 FAILED (did not finish: time or best lap ≥ 60000), +6 SCORE (cumulative stunt points). LOST is derived as PLAYED − WON. P2 is counted only when its rider index is < 16, so CPU opponents are not counted. Static (`80:C775`, `83:97DA`) plus runtime: rider 0 (R-2026-10-03-UI-19) and a VS timeout (R-2026-10-04-UI-21). `analysis/generated/progression-sram-semantics.json`.

entries.name: Save_TrackRecords
entries.notes: `0x0422 + 2*(50*rank + 5*tour_row + track)`. Rank 0/1/2 = GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE rows (1st/2nd/3rd best). Race = finish time and circuit = best lap (1/100 s; 60000 = NO TIME); stunt = score (0 = none). `analysis/generated/track-records-sram.json`.

entries.name: Save_TrackRecordsChecksum
entries.notes: 16-bit sum of the 150 `Save_TrackRecords` words.

entries.name: Save_TrackRecordHolders
entries.notes: Holder rider index per record (same index as `Save_TrackRecords`; 16 = `someone`).

entries.name: Save_LastRaceResultP1` / `Save_LastRaceResultP2
entries.notes: Last race result value for P1 / the opponent (time in 1/100 s, circuit total, or stunt score), rewritten every race.

entries.name: Progress_MedalMatrix
entries.notes: SRAM-backed medal matrix. `83:9EB4` computes `16*tour + unicycle`; the result path at `83:8823-8838` increments the selected cell and saturates at 3. Rows 0..8 are Crawler, Jumper, Shuffler, Bounder, Walker, Runner, Hopper, Sprinter, Hunter. Values are 0 none, 1 bronze, 2 silver, 3 gold.

entries.name: Progress_BlockChecksum
entries.notes: `83:90F4` sums 170 16-bit words across SRAM `05E8..073B` and stores the result here. The entire medal matrix lies inside this protected range.

entries.name: Progress_TourTrackFlags
entries.notes: One flag per track, `0x1075 + 5*tour_row + track` (`$CE`): set by a qualifying 1P result (`83:87F5`); a full row of 5 awards the medal and is cleared (`83:8805`/`881B`/`895B`). Zeroed when a rider is confirmed (`80:BBC1`), so unfinished tours do not survive a power cycle. Outside the `0x073C` checksum (R-2026-10-04-UI-20).

entries.name: Save_VsWinTally
entries.notes: P1 / P2 win counts, zeroed on VS entry (`80:BD05`) and shown on VS track select. `0x10A9` also counts 1P wins, harmlessly. Not the tour gate (R-2026-10-04-UI-21).

entries.name: Save_PlayMode
entries.notes: 1 = 1P tour (`80:BBD6`), 2 = VS (`80:BD12`), 0 = exited. Gates the tour-progress paths.

entries.name: Progress_SplashCheatActive
entries.notes: Set by the Up-Left-Up-R-A splash cheat (`80:F549`); selects the CHEAT! ending page (`83:ABB3`); cleared, and tiers restored from `0x10E3`, on the next splash pass (R-2026-10-04-UI-22).

entries.name: Progress_TourEntryMedal
entries.notes: Medal cell snapshot when a tour is confirmed (`80:E6BF`). Drives the BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD run label; leaving TRACK_SELECT keeps the tour flags only if the medal is unchanged.

entries.name: Progress_RiderTier` / `Progress_RiderTierBackup
entries.notes: Per-rider tier 0-3 from the medal thresholds (`83:9F49`); 3 opens the nine-tour page with Hunter. The splash cheat copies tiers to the backup and sets all to 3.

entries.name: Progress_UnicycleTier
entries.notes: Derived per-unicycle progression tier. After a medal result, `83:885D-88C9` scans that unicycle through the first eight tour rows and writes tier 1 for 4 medals, tier 2 for 6 silver-or-better medals, or tier 3 for 8 gold medals through `83:9F49`. The recovered all-silver/no-Hunter and with-Hunter snapshots independently match tier values 2 and 3.

entries.name: Progress_UnicycleTierMirror
entries.notes: `83:9F81` writes the same derived tier and index as `Progress_UnicycleTier`. Exact downstream distinction between the two tables remains open.

entries.name: Race_ActiveState
entries.notes: Recovered bot label `inRace`; verified as `0x01` after deterministic race entry in both native and Snes9x/snesref runs. Non-race screens can contain other transient values, so only `0x01 = active race` is currently asserted.

entries.name: Race_LoopParityPhase
entries.notes: Race-loop code at `83:CC94-CC9A` computes `1 - $0302` and stores it back every loop iteration, so the byte alternates `0/1`. Racer-update branches at `82:8C3B` (P1) and `82:9122` (P2), plus common physics at `82:A39C/A3A4`, use this parity to choose alternating work. This is the former fixture label `phase2`.

entries.name: Race_LoopModulo3Phase
entries.notes: Race-loop code at `83:CC87-CC91` increments the byte and wraps `3 -> 0` every loop iteration. This is the former fixture label `phase3`; use it with `$0302` when diagnosing intra-frame race-loop alignment.

entries.name: Player1/2_NextCheckpoint
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map and `Race_HandleCheckpointFinish` identify the paired checkpoint slots. Run `36801728342` matches native/reference progression `0 → 1 → 3 → 1` across the deterministic Dragster route and results.

entries.name: Player1/2_FinishGate
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map reports zero as the state in which the finish line may be crossed; `Race_HandleCheckpointFinish` gates on and mutates the slots. Run `36801728342` matches native/reference `0 → 1 → 0 → 1` phase changes through the stock finish.

entries.name: Player1/2_LapsRemaining
entries.notes: Paired lap counters. Race setup initializes them at `82:DBF7/DBFA`; `Race_HandleCheckpointFinish` reads, decrements and stores the active player's counter at `81:819E-81A2`.

entries.name: Course_ActiveDecodedPayload
entries.notes: Confirmed by run 36514985916: active Dragster decoded stream 1 matches 33,814/33,815 bytes from this address; only decoded byte 11 is runtime-mutated.

entries.name: Course_ResourceListCursor
entries.notes: `Course_LoadAndMaterialize` reads this word as an offset from `7F:0000`, increments it once per resource ID consumed, and stops on `FF`. Dragster initializes it to `0x840F` and finishes at `0x8416`, exactly explaining the historical `0x0F→0x16` low-byte mutation.

entries.name: Course_RuntimeObjectMap
entries.notes: Authoritative course behavior plane materialized during course load. `81:82E6` derives an index from `CurrentPlayer_CollisionContactWord` (`$0F09`), reads an object byte, clears bit 0, and dispatches through a bounded behavior jump table. Runtime object code `0x14` selects the confirmed checkpoint/finish handler. Camera position and the `$0DCD/$0DCF` VRAM-update lists do not participate in this activation decision. Exact dimensions/layout remain to be mapped.

entries.name: CameraVramDmaReady
entries.notes: Ready flags for the camera-derived VRAM-strip descriptor queue. `81:ACB1` sets the selected slot to 1; NMI consumer `82:D19B..D2D0` clears the flag immediately before emission.

entries.name: CameraVramDmaSource
entries.notes: Low-WRAM source addresses for camera-strip DMA descriptors. In the representative single-view horizontal path, slot 2 uses `$0433`.

entries.name: CameraVramDmaSize
entries.notes: Byte counts for camera-strip DMA descriptors. Steady horizontal slot 2 uses `$0020`, one 16-word column; vertical row descriptors use count-derived sizes such as `$0022`.

entries.name: CameraVramDmaDestination
entries.notes: VRAM destinations for camera-strip DMA descriptors. For the single-view horizontal slot, `81:AB88` stores `$0C00 + $0505`; run `36966728136` observes the 32-column ring wrap `$0D9F -> $0D80`.

entries.name: CameraVramDmaVmain
entries.notes: VMAIN modes for camera-strip DMA descriptors. Horizontal column slot 2 uses `$81` (VRAM increment 32 after the high-byte write); the complementary row path uses `$80`.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_CollisionContactWord
entries.notes: Collision/contact result consumed by the course-object dispatcher. `81:82E6` computes C000 index `(($0F09 & $03F0) >> 2) + (($0F09 & $000F) >> 1)`. The collision resolver clears and reconstructs the value from gathered candidates; racer marshaling persists it through `$0E95/$0E97`. This is the gameplay activation boundary for the representative checkpoint/finish object family, distinct from camera-driven presentation preparation.

entries.name: Player1_XPosition
entries.notes: Effective recovered-bot word key `xPos`. Race-acceleration run 36512546762 moves it identically in native/reference from 1088 at rest to 1655 under staged Right input, alongside positive X speed.

entries.name: Player1_YPosition
entries.notes: Effective recovered-bot word key `yPos`. Sustained-B run 36514981164 causally changes player 1 from ground Y=859 in the matched no-B control to Y=797 while airborne; native and Snes9x match exactly.

entries.name: Player1_XSpeed
entries.notes: Effective recovered-bot word key `xSpeed`; bot explicitly sign-converts it. Race-acceleration run 36512546762 changes it identically from 0 to +447 under Right input while X position increases. Cross-build equivalents proven by racer-update dataflow: PAL prototype `7E:04B7`; Europe retail `7E:04BB`.

entries.name: Player1_YSpeed
entries.notes: Effective recovered-bot word key `ySpeed`; bot sign-converts it. In run 36514981164 sustained B changes it causally from 0 in the matched control to -21 while player 1 is airborne; native and Snes9x match exactly. Cross-build equivalents proven by racer-update dataflow: PAL prototype `7E:04BB`; Europe retail `7E:04BF`.

entries.name: Player1_AirTime
entries.notes: Dynamic run 36514981164 causally changes the low byte from 0 to 9 under sustained B while Y position/speed enter the airborne trajectory. Nitrodon's WRAM map identifies the slot as time in air with a 9-frame maximum, and bank-82 stunt code reads it as a word (`LDA $0545,Y`). Historical bots read only the low byte.

entries.name: Player2_AirTime
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies this into shared current-player air-time `$0F29` for the P2 pass, exactly parallel to verified P1 `$0545`; the common stunt pipeline consumes the shared value.

entries.name: Player1_PitchAngle
entries.notes: Persistent player-1 pitch/orientation. From control angle `0x07`, eight L frames produce `0x37` (= 7−16 mod 64) and eight R frames produce `0x17` (= 7+16 mod 64), identically native/reference. ROM `02:8D84` copies working `$0F49` into this slot.

entries.name: Player2_PitchAngle
entries.notes: Paired player-2 pitch/orientation slot. Sibling ROM routine at `02:9272` executes `LDY $0F49; STY $04C9`; surrounding destinations shift coherently to player-2 fields.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_PitchScratch
entries.notes: Historical bot reads this as `pitch`, but static sibling routines copy the same working value into persistent player-1 `$04C7` or player-2 `$04C9` slots. L-vs-control checkpoints leave `$0F49` unchanged while `$04C7` changes causally, so it should not be treated as stable player-1 storage.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_HalfTwistCount
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map identifies this as the current-player number of half-twists. The stunt finalizer at `02:9C2E` shifts it right once to derive full twists, caps the result at 4, and feeds that into the stunt-combination index. Writer analysis independently shows current-player copy/clear/increment behavior.

entries.name: Player1_TabletopDuration
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map and annotated bank-82 code identify this as tabletop duration; `INC $042F,X` at `02:9582` advances it and `02:9C87` requires duration >= 3 to emit the Tabletop message. Dynamic run 36776825024 independently observes X input driving low-byte `0→1→2→3→4→0` at a two-frame cadence in native and pinned Snes9x. This supersedes the older accumulated-count label.

entries.name: Player1_ZFlipCount
entries.width: 16-bit slot; low byte used by USJO
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map identifies the player-specific slot as Z-flip count. Bank-82 code reads/writes it under 16-bit accumulator mode, caps the landing result at 4, and uses it directly in the stunt-combination index. USJO v8 reads only the low byte.

entries.name: Player1_RollCount
entries.width: 16-bit slot; low byte used by USJO
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map explicitly records a 2-byte player-1 roll count. The stunt routine increments it with 16-bit `INC $11F9,X` after four quarter-turn progress steps, and may credit a 3/4 roll on landing. USJO v8 reads only the low byte.

entries.name: Player1_FlipCount
entries.width: 16-bit slot; low byte used by USJO
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map explicitly records a 2-byte player-1 flip count. The stunt routine increments it with 16-bit `INC $11FD,X` after four quarter-turn progress steps, and may credit a 3/4 flip on landing. USJO v8 reads only the low byte.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_BoostMeterWorking
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` proves this is the shared boost workspace: P1 `11CF → 11CD` at `82:8BA2-8BA5` and `11CD → 11CF` at `82:8CF1-8CF4`; P2 `11D1 → 11CD` at `82:8EB1-8EB4` and `11CD → 11D1` at `82:91D9-91DC`. Movement/stunt code then mutates the working value.

entries.name: Player1_ZRotationState
entries.width: 16-bit slot; low byte used by USJO
entries.notes: Static scan run 36769525945 exposes paired copy structure: `02:8AB2` loads `$0DFD` and stores it to shared working `$0F57`, while `02:8FBA` loads paired `$0DFF` into the same working slot and `02:8DB2` copies `$0F57` back to `$0DFD`. This strongly supports `$0DFD/$0DFF` as paired persistent racer Z-state slots; exact physical interpretation remains open.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_ZRotationWorking
entries.width: 16-bit working slot; low byte used by USJO
entries.notes: Static scan run 36769525945 shows `$0F57` as shared current-player working state: `02:8AB2` copies player-1 `$0DFD` into it, `02:8FBA` copies paired `$0DFF` into it, `02:8DB2` writes it back to `$0DFD`, and later bank-02 code mutates/clears it. USJO v8 calls the low byte `zprerotation`; exact physical semantics remain open.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_XVelocityWorking
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map identifies current-player X velocity here. Bank-81 collision/transform code reads `$0F9F/$0FA1`, transforms both through matrix terms, and stores the new X/Y pair back; bank-82 movement and boost paths also mutate `$0F9F`. This resolves USJO's old “alternative speed” comment as shared current-player working state rather than a second player-1 field.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_YVelocityWorking
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map and bank-81 velocity transform pair this with `$0F9F`; bank-82 vertical-acceleration code at `02:A968` updates this slot directly.

entries.name: CurrentPlayer_Index
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` explicitly stores `0` before the P1 simulation pass at `82:8C22-8C24` and `2` before the P2 pass at `82:910C-910E`; stunt/movement code then uses it to index paired player slots.

entries.name: Player1_BoostMeter
entries.notes: Persistent P1 boost slot. `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies `11CF → 11CD` before the common P1 simulation pass and writes `11CD → 11CF` afterward. Independently, the P1 message consumer at `81:C167-C17D` applies nonnegative per-message rewards from the signed word table at `81:C4AA` directly to `11CF`, closing the delayed stunt-reward path. Cross-build equivalents: PAL prototype `7E:11D3` ↔ working `7E:11D1`; Europe retail `7E:11D9` ↔ working `7E:11D7`.

entries.name: Player2_BoostMeter
entries.notes: Persistent P2 boost slot. `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies `11D1 → 11CD` before the common P2 simulation pass and writes `11CD → 11D1` afterward. The mirrored P2 message consumer at `81:C2AA-C2BF` applies the same nonnegative per-message reward table directly to `11D1`. Cross-build equivalents: PAL prototype `7E:11D5`; Europe retail `7E:11DB`, each recovered as the unique second boost slot paired with that build's shared boost workspace.

entries.name: Player2_XPosition
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies this into the same DP/current-player X-position slot used by verified P1 `$0411` and writes the simulated value back after the P2 pass; recovered Dessyreqt tools independently use the same address. Cross-build equivalents recovered from the same bidirectional relation: PAL prototype `7E:0413`; Europe retail `7E:0417`.

entries.name: Player2_YPosition
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies this into the same DP/current-player Y-position slot used by verified P1 `$0415` and writes the simulated value back after the P2 pass; recovered Dessyreqt tools independently use the same address. Cross-build equivalents: PAL prototype `7E:0417`; Europe retail `7E:041B`.

entries.name: Player2_XSpeed
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` maps this to shared `CurrentPlayer_XVelocityWorking` `$0F9F` before the P2 simulation pass and writes it back afterward; Dessyreqt independently labels the same field. Cross-build equivalents recovered from the same relation: PAL prototype `7E:04B9`; Europe retail `7E:04BD`.

entries.name: Player2_YSpeed
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` maps this to shared `CurrentPlayer_YVelocityWorking` `$0FA1` before the P2 simulation pass and writes it back afterward; Dessyreqt independently labels the same field. Cross-build equivalents: PAL prototype `7E:04BD`; Europe retail `7E:04C1`.

entries.name: Player2_FacedDirection
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies this into the same shared `$0F47` slot used by P1 facing and writes it back after the P2 pass; Nitrodon and Dessyreqt independently identify the field.

entries.name: Player2_TabletopDuration
entries.notes: Nitrodon's WRAM map identifies player-2 tabletop duration here; Dessyreqt's Tabletop bot and `Races2.wch` independently use the same paired address.

entries.name: Player2_ZFlipCount
entries.notes: Nitrodon's WRAM map identifies the paired player-2 Z-flip field; Dessyreqt's `Races2.wch` independently labels it Z-Flips.

entries.name: Player2_RollCount
entries.notes: Nitrodon's WRAM map identifies a two-byte player-2 roll count; Dessyreqt's `Races2.wch` independently labels the same address Rolls.

entries.name: Player2_FlipCount
entries.notes: Nitrodon's WRAM map identifies a two-byte player-2 flip count; Dessyreqt's `Races2.wch` independently labels the same address Flips.

entries.name: Player2_NextCheckpoint
entries.notes: Nitrodon's WRAM map and Dessyreqt's `Races2.wch` independently identify the paired player-2 checkpoint slot.

entries.name: Player1_CameraXSpeed
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map calls this player-1 camera X velocity; Dessyreqt's `Races.wch` and SCUM independently use it as Camera X Speed. SCUM sign-converts the byte.

entries.name: Player2_CameraXSpeed
entries.notes: Dessyreqt's `Races2.wch` identifies this paired player-2 Camera X Speed slot. Pairing with corroborated player-1 `$04F5` is strong, but direct runtime validation is still open.

entries.name: Player1_RollQuarterProgress
entries.notes: Bank-82 stunt code increments this progress value and converts it into one roll when it reaches 4, then resets it; paired player-2 slot is `$1203`.

entries.name: Player1_FlipQuarterProgress
entries.notes: Bank-82 stunt code increments this progress value and converts it into one flip when it reaches 4, then resets it; paired player-2 slot is `$1207`.

entries.name: Player1_FacingAtTakeoff
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map says this records whether the racer was facing right when leaving the ground. The stunt finalizer uses it to decide whether accumulated quarter-turn direction maps to flip versus roll; paired player-2 slot is `$033D`.

entries.name: Player1_NextCheckpoint
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map identifies the next-checkpoint field; paired player-2 slot is `$119B`. High-value race-finish fixture target.

entries.name: Player1_FinishGateState
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map records `0` when player 1 can cross the finish line; paired player-2 slot is `$119F`. Exact nonzero state meanings remain open.

entries.name: Player1_LapsRemaining
entries.notes: Nitrodon's map identifies laps remaining; paired player-2 slot is `$0EF3`.

entries.name: Player1_StuntScoreDisplayCache
entries.notes: Bank 81 proves this is a display-side cache rather than the score accumulator: `81:C37F` loads backing score `77:07BB`, `C383` compares it with `12AF`, `C388` stores a changed value, then `C38B-C3E7` decomposes it into decimal display digits. P1 queue consumption mutates `77:07BB` directly.

entries.name: Player1_StuntScore
entries.notes: Backing P1 stunt-track score. The P1 message consumer adds a per-message reward byte at `81:C13D-C141`; the display path reads this value at `81:C37F` and mirrors changes into `7E:12AF`. Initialized with the surrounding race/stunt state in bank 82.

entries.name: Player2_StuntScore
entries.notes: P2 counterpart of `77:07BB`. The mirrored P2 message consumer adds the reward at `81:C282-C286`; the display path reads it at `81:C3EA`.

entries.name: Player1_StuntAirLatch
entries.notes: Olivier retained this as an “Air flag”; Nitrodon's stunt disassembly shows `02:9A97` setting indexed `$1361` to 1 during stunt-air initialization and `02:9D88` clearing it during finalization. Exact relationship to ordinary air-time `$0545` remains open.

entries.name: Player1_ScreenX
entries.notes: `Race_BuildRacerOAMState` computes this from P1 world X `0411` relative to camera X `0419`, after viewport scaling/culling and wrap masking. Offscreen fallback stores `0x70`. This corrects the older generic TAS label “Screen X Position.”

entries.name: Player1_ScreenY
entries.notes: `Race_BuildRacerOAMState` stores projected P1 Y here from `0415 - 041D`; offscreen fallback stores `0x70`.

entries.name: Player2_ScreenX
entries.notes: P2 counterpart of `1509`, projected from `0413` relative to camera `0419` through the same horizontal policy.

entries.name: Player2_ScreenY
entries.notes: P2 counterpart of `150A`, projected from `0417 - 041D`; offscreen fallback stores `0x70`.

entries.name: Player1_MessageQueue
entries.notes: `81:C5B3` appends P1 messages at index `0CE3` with 5-bit wrap; `0CE1` is the opposing queue index. Dessyreqt v14a independently parses this ring for pending stunt credit.

entries.name: Player1_MessageQueueReadIndex
entries.notes: Opposing P1 ring index used by enqueue/full checks and historical v14a queue traversal. Exact consumer naming should be verified at the dequeue site.

entries.name: Player1_MessageQueueWriteIndex
entries.notes: `81:C5B3` writes at this index, then increments it modulo 32.

entries.name: Player2_MessageQueue
entries.notes: P2 ring used by the same enqueue routine; write index `0D0D`, opposing index `0D0B`.

entries.name: Player2_MessageQueueWriteIndex
entries.notes: P2 enqueue index; incremented modulo 32 by `81:C5B3`.

entries.name: Player1_FacedDirection
entries.notes: `Race_UpdateRacersFrame` copies this into shared `$0F47` for the P1 pass and writes it back afterward; recovered bot semantics give 1 = right, 0 = left. Exact value convention still lacks an isolated causal test.

entries.name: Player1_ArrowsVisible
entries.notes: Effective duplicate-key address used by recovered bot; 0 means direction arrows showing.

entries.name: Player1_ArrowDirection
entries.notes: Effective duplicate-key address used by recovered bot; 0 = right, 1 = left.

entries.name: Race_CountdownTimer
entries.notes: Recovered bot word key shared by players. In run 36512546762 it decreases identically in native/reference by exactly `0x0100` per guest frame across the staged pre-start/acceleration checkpoints. Exact game-facing units/threshold meanings remain to be named.

entries.name: Race_ReverseControls
entries.notes: Recovered bot: 2 = controls reversed, 0 = normal. Not yet independently validated.
